gloss: to withdraw; to draw back; to stay indoors

definitions.gloss: to withdraw; to draw back; to recede
definitions.explanation: For something to move back or recede, like swelling going down or a turtle withdrawing into its shell.

definitions.gloss: to stay indoors; to retire from public life
definitions.explanation: To remain at home or in seclusion, not going out or appearing in public.

definitions.gloss: to back off; to butt out; to stay out of it
definitions.explanation: Used to tell someone to stay out of something that doesn't concern them.

examples.japanese: {腫|は}れが{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: The swelling has started to go down.

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}が{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んで{楽|らく}になった。
examples.english: The fever went down and I felt better.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{塗|ぬ}ったら、{赤|あか}みがすぐに{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: When I applied medicine, the redness quickly receded.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{田舎|いなか}に{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んだ。
{定年後|ていねんご}は{家|いえ}に{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: After retirement, I've been staying at home.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{家|いえ}に{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んで{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: On rainy days, I stay indoors and read books.

examples.japanese: {関係|かんけい}ないんだから、{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んでてくれ。
examples.english: It's none of your business, so butt out.

examples.japanese: {素人|しろうと}は{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んでいたほうがいい。
examples.english: Amateurs should stay out of it.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). Transitive counterpart: {引|ひ}っ{込|こ}める.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-む type)
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}みます (polite)
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んだ (past)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}んでろ！- Butt out! Stay out of it!
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん} - shy, retiring disposition

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{腫|は}れが{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}む - swelling goes down
・{田舎|いなか}に{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}む - to retire to the countryside
・{熱|ねつ}が{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}む - fever goes down

RELATED:
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す - to move (to a new house)
・{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}める - to withdraw, retract (transitive)

REGISTER:
Neutral to casual. Common in everyday conversation.
